name: Lending and Credit Policy
summary: Comprehensive policy covering credit appraisal, sanction limits, delegation of powers, collateral valuation, NPA management, and recovery procedures. Updated to align with RBI Master Direction on Loans and Advances (2024).

name: Investment Policy
summary: Policy governing SLR/Non-SLR investments, HTM/HFT/AFS classification, broker empanelment, exposure limits, valuation methodology, and compliance with RBI investment guidelines for UCBs.

name: KYC and AML Policy
summary: Customer due diligence procedures, risk categorization, periodic KYC timelines, PEP identification, transaction monitoring, STR/CTR filing procedures. Currently under review to incorporate latest FATF recommendations.

name: Information Security Policy
summary: Access control, password policy, data classification, encryption standards, incident response, business continuity, disaster recovery. Policy overdue for annual review - updated version incorporating RBI Cyber Security Framework in draft.

name: Human Resources Policy
summary: Recruitment, onboarding, performance management, compensation, leave, disciplinary procedures, code of conduct, conflict of interest, whistleblower mechanism.

name: Internal Audit Charter
summary: Purpose, authority, responsibility of Internal Audit function. CAE reporting lines, independence, audit methodology. Policy significantly overdue for review - revision in progress to align with IIA Standards 2017 (revised 2024) and RBI guidelines.

name: Risk Management Policy
summary: Risk governance structure, risk appetite framework, credit risk, market risk, operational risk, liquidity risk, IT risk, compliance risk. Risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring. ICAAP framework.

name: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Policy
summary: BCP/DR governance, crisis management team, business impact analysis, recovery time objectives (RTO), recovery point objectives (RPO), DR site specifications, quarterly DR drill requirements.
